console_mode.description: PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱): present exactly when the start belongs to a direct-mode model action (audited fallback) — correlated to the console_mode_transition via transition_id.

transition_id.description: PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱): the console → direct transition this start belongs to (present together with console_mode).

trace_id.description: PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱): the console trace id of the direct action (call_id).
